addressed.claim_id: Date validation now requires ASCII digits only and exact full-string match (fullmatch with [0-9] instead of \d and $), rejecting Unicode digits and trailing newline.

Amount cent-exactness check replaced context-limited quantize(Decimal("0.01")) with exact tuple/exponent check (zero-aware trailing-zero test) so large finite amounts cannot leak InvalidOperation and remain ValueError; all decimal failures map to ValueError.
